user_prompt: I need to pull together both our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning, and simultaneously check our procurement records to ensure all our vendor relationships maintain proper safety standings before we move forward with any new initiatives.

steps.step_name: Pull together our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning

args.reason: Directly automates capability gap analysis and workforce planning to assess if internal staff are adequately skilled for planned changes.

method_trace.picked_reason: Directly automates capability gap analysis and workforce planning to assess if internal staff are adequately skilled for planned changes.

steps.step_name: Check our procurement records to ensure all our vendor relationships maintain proper safety standings before we move forward with new initiatives

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (11 total):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO APIs
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM
  * apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (compensation & tax reconciliation)
  * agents: CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine, SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator
- sap.s4: ERP
  * apiResource:MaterialReceiptInboundAPI:v1 (goods receipt)
  * agents: AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator, BOMComplianceAutomationAgent, ProcurementMatchingAgent, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine, IncidentRootCauseAutomationEngine, EngineeringChangeOrchestrator
- sap.crm: CRM agents only, NO customer case mgmt APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents: IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator, IncidentResponseCoordinator, VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator, VendorComplianceInvoiceAutomation, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator
- sap.ariba: Procurement agents + APIs
  * agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation (vendor invoices matching)
  * agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator (monitors engineering changes & material mods)
  * apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI
  * apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt agents only
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing agents
  * agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer (segment analysis & campaign targeting)
  * agent:OpportunityEngagementOrchestrator (monitors interactions, orchestrates engagement, identifies high-value transitions)
  * agent:VendorProcurementAutomationOrchestrator (vendor engagement campaigns)
  * agent:IncidentComplianceOrchestrator (risk event response)
  * agent:VendorContractJourneyCoordinator (vendor journey orchestration)
  * agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator (product change coordination with engagement)
- my.mes: Manufacturing Execution
  * apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1 (machine performance OEE, NOT queue status)
  * agents: ProductionQualityMonitor, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator, ProductionChangeOrchestrator, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM agents: BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention, SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator
- sap.odm: Entity type repository

KEY FINDINGS:
- Campaign engagement & contact tracking: emarsys.cx:agent:OpportunityEngagementOrchestrator
- VENDOR SAFETY COMPLIANCE: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1 (validates vendor safety certifications & compliance status, monitors contract adherence to EHS requirements)

args.reason: Automates vendor safety compliance verification and monitors adherence to EHS requirements across procurement records before new initiatives.

method_trace.picked_reason: Automates vendor safety compliance verification and monitors adherence to EHS requirements across procurement records before new initiatives.
